Privacy Policy

Last updated November 25, 2026.

1. Who we are

This website is operated by SMARCTEK LLC, 2389 Main Street, Glastonbury, Connecticut 06033, USA. You can reach us at info@smarctekllc.com.

2. Information we collect

  • Enquiry details. When you submit the enquiry form we receive your name, company, business email, phone number, country, industry, the equipment you select, capacity, project location, timeline, your description and any files you attach.
  • Correspondence. Emails and calls with our team.
  • Technical data. Our web server records standard request information such as IP address, time and page requested, used for security and troubleshooting.
  • Quote list. The machines you add to your quote list are kept in your own browser storage and are sent to us only if you submit the form.

This site does not currently use advertising or analytics cookies. If that changes, this policy and a consent banner will be updated first.

3. Third-party services

  • Google Fonts. Fonts are loaded from Google, which receives your IP address and browser details when a page loads.
  • Email delivery. Enquiries are delivered to us through an email delivery provider.
  • Spam protection. The form uses hidden checks and may use a bot-detection service such as Cloudflare Turnstile.

4. How we use information

We use enquiry information to respond to you, prepare quotations, discuss technical requirements and keep records of our business dealings. We also use it to protect the site against abuse and to meet legal obligations.

5. Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may share enquiry details with equipment suppliers where this is needed to prepare a quotation you have asked for, with service providers who help us run the site and email, and with advisers or authorities where the law requires.

6. International use

We are based in the United States. If you contact us from another country, your information is processed in the United States.

7. Retention

We keep enquiry information for as long as it is needed to deal with your enquiry and any resulting business relationship, and for legal and accounting purposes.

8. Your choices and rights

You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing info@smarctekllc.com. Depending on where you live, additional rights may apply.

9. Security

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect information. No online transmission is completely secure.

10. Children

This site is intended for business users and is not directed at children.

11. Changes

We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the latest version.
